timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: People keep saying Copilot will leak secrets. Is the AI stealing things?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Usually no. It surfaces data the user already has permission to read.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So the real problem is oversharing?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. AI makes messy permissions painfully visible.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Classify sensitive data, tighten access, remove stale sharing links, and enforce retention policies.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. Sensitivity labels, DLP, audit, eDiscovery, and data lifecycle controls are central.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about prompts with confidential info?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Log usage, set policy boundaries, educate users, and monitor risky data movement.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So AI readiness is data hygiene?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Brutally so. Copilot is a mirror. Sometimes the mirror has incident response energy.
